title: John D NDE 4371
content: I came to on the shoulder of the oncoming traffic, and I was headed for a deep ditch. I over corrected and was sideways in the gravel. I could feel the tires starting to give way, knew I was going to roll, and yelled, 'OH GOD!' two or three times then there was a bang. Everything stopped. I was totally conscious, but didn't know where I was, totally void of light yet I could still see - I was aware of myself and I don't remember having a body, just a consciousness. I looked around or at the darkness; it was right in front of me and far away. Then it was like looking at a black canvass with no beginning or end and it was silent, at first. Then sounds I really can't explain, I became aware of presences, coupled with the darkness becoming textured and streaked with ashen grays and a burning, scraping sound. I heard screaming and crying. I never saw what was causing it but with each streak I became more terrified and knew I wasn't in a good place, and whatever was trying to come 'through' the darkness, meant to do me harm. I felt like I was surrounded by the darkness but not IN the darkness yet. I know that I realized I wanted to leave and never be here again! I believe that I was at the Devil's doorstep. I think I was given a brief look at where my current path was leading me and that I was literally smacked in the head by GOD himself to get my attention and get back on the right path. It really can't be given justice through words, not even a picture could communicate it. I did my best to explain it but when I read it, it just doesn't convey what it was like, not even a little bit.

arrival.other_being_detail: Became aware of 'presences' and felt whatever was trying to come 'through' the darkness meant to do harm; interpreted as being at 'the Devil's doorstep.'

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Vehicle loss of control/impact ('there was a bang. Everything stopped.').

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Entered/experienced a dark void with threatening presences, screaming/crying, and terror; interpreted as 'the Devil's doorstep.'

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Totally void of light yet could still see; darkness like a 'black canvass with no beginning or end' that became 'textured and streaked with ashen grays' accompanied by a 'burning, scraping sound' and screaming/crying; felt something trying to come 'through' the darkness to do harm; interpreted as 'the Devil's doorstep.'
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “Everything stopped. I was totally conscious, but didn't know where I was, totally void of light yet I could still see - I was aware of myself and I don't remember having a body, just a consciousness.”
